proposal.root_cause: Repair turn is starved of evidence: it only probes literals already in the draft against arbitrary columns, so clean-but-empty queries caused by filtering on the wrong column (or on non-existent columns) get no information about where the value actually lives
proposal.what: Rewrite the evidence gatherer in solve.py: probe keywords taken from the question/hint as well as the SQL literals against every text column of every table (exact/case-insensitive first, then substring), list distinct values of short low-cardinality text columns, and report SQLite errors from probes (which enumerate real column names, exposing hallucinated filter/join columns); feed this plus a wrong-column checklist into the existing single repair call.
